How it works

From source
to sink.

Clean water doesn’t just happen. Follow the carefully monitored journey that brings safe, reliable water to 146,000 people every day.

  1. 01
    ⌁

    Protected source

    Rain and snowmelt collect across a forested, monitored watershed.

  2. 02
    ✣

    Careful treatment

    Filtration and disinfection remove particles and microorganisms.

  3. 03
    ⇢

    Reliable delivery

    920 miles of public mains carry water to every service district.

  4. 04
    ⌂

    Your tap

    Continuous sampling safeguards quality all the way to your home.
